name: Paisalo Digital Limited
summary: Paisalo Digital Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in providing loans through its financial products in India. It offers small income generation loans, including Umeed loans, Pragati loans, and Vikas loans for self-employed individuals and small business owners in rural and semi-urban areas, supporting sectors like agriculture, retail, and handicrafts. The company also provides mobility loans, such as Gati loans for auto and electric rickshaw drivers, Raftaar loans for small vehicle owners, Do Ka Dum loans for two-wheeler purchase, and Ready Steady Go loans to purchase pre-owned cars; and entrepreneurial loans, including Udaan loans to empower entrepreneurs for business growth…
